control: 'Sales' link of the manager top bar and 'Show' button of the filter (GET /reports/sales?from=&to=&hub=)
inputs_validation: manager role only; From and To are calendar days in Ho Chi Minh City time, default the last 7 days; From not after To; at most 366 days; hub from the list or empty; report is read only (BR-20, BR-21, BR-24)
displayed_result: Filter plus table 'Hub, Orders, Dishes, Vouchers, Delivery fees, Total, Refunds owed, Net' in a scroll box, an 'All hubs' total row, the note on how Total and Net are built, and 'Best-selling dishes'; an empty period shows 'No delivered orders in this period.' with zero totals; a refused filter shows a red message such as 'The first day must be on or before the last day.' (400) and no figures

control: 'Workload' link of the manager top bar (GET /reports/workload)
inputs_validation: no input and no date filter, a snapshot of now; manager only; read only; every hub is listed, archived ones marked '(Archived)' (BR-01, BR-22, BR-24)
displayed_result: 'As of <time>' and one row per hub: New, Confirmed, Preparing, Load / capacity, Load %, Status (Busy, Quiet or Normal) and Ready and On the way counts

control: 'Delivery' link of the manager top bar and its 'Show' button (GET /reports/delivery?from=&to=&hub=)
inputs_validation: same filter rules as the sales report; deliveries that ended in the period; failure rate is failed / (delivered + failed) and shows 'n/a' when nothing ended; every average shows its sample size (n=) (BR-20, BR-23, BR-24)
displayed_result: Tables 'By hub' (with an 'All deliveries' row) and 'By shipper': Delivered, Failed, Failure rate, Avg wait and Avg ride in minutes with (n=...); 'n/a (n=0)' when there is no sample; an empty period shows 'No delivery ended in this period.'; an invalid filter shows a red message and no tables
